name: supermanager
description: Turns the main session into a coordinator of agent teammates, with weekly sprints, task files and a Tasks pane.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Opens task files from the Tasks pane.

sprintWeeks.title: Sprint length (weeks)
sprintWeeks.description: How many weeks one sprint lasts.
